subject: Access gatekeeper run-through & invite sequencing
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Rodgers <sam.rodgers@cloverhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Access gatekeeper run-through & invite sequencing

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our onboarding call, below is a concise plan for initial tenant setup and access provisioning so we can seed keys, invite your admins, and create the first sandbox project without impacting production. Please review the asks (bold) and reply with the short list so we can lock dates.

High-level timeline (target week of Dec 13):
- Dec 13: Create tenant & seed two API keys (one for integration testing, one for ingestion).
- Dec 14: Invite 3 CloverHealth admin users (Owner, Billing, Security) and confirm RBAC mapping.
- Dec 15: Walkthrough session — join for 30 minutes to validate invites and test token usage.

Immediate asks for you (Sam/Nadia):
1) Please confirm the email addresses for 3 initial admins and desired role label for each (e.g., Admin / Billing / Security).
2) Provide a single example IP range you want added to the allowlist for the initial test keys (or say "no IP restriction").

Attachments: I attached an access matrix template to capture the admin emails/roles and a quickstart checklist — fill and send back.

If that schedule works I’ll go ahead and seed the keys in our staging workspace and share ephemeral values in a secure note.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--Attachment: clover_access_matrix_template.csv (CSV stub, fields: name,email,role,project,notes)
--Attachment: redwood_quickstart-onboarding-checklist.pdf (1 page)
From: Sam Rodgers <sam.rodgers@cloverhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access gatekeeper run-through & invite sequencing

Thanks Marcus — quick clarifications: 

- Admins: Nadia Perez (nadia.perez@cloverhealth.com) as Owner, Mike Torres (mike.torres@cloverhealth.com) as Billing, and Priya Shah (priya.shah@cloverhealth.com) as Security.
- For the IP allowlist, we prefer to start without restrictions for the integration key and add an allowlist once we've validated the traffic pattern. Is that acceptable?

Also: are the seeded API keys long-lived service keys or short-lived tokens tied to a service principal? We want to avoid manual key rotation work.

Sam
Sam Rodgers
Head of Platform Integrations | CloverHealth
sam.rodgers@cloverhealth.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: seeding plan & role mapping for CloverHealth

Team —

Following Sam's reply: they want 3 invites and prefer initially no IP allowlist for the integration key. Proposed internal split: 

- Monica: seed the two keys in staging (integration/test & ingestion) on Dec 13, mark the integration key as "no allowlist" and set ingestion key to require rotation after 90 days.
- Soojin: prepare RBAC entries and the invite email templates (Owner, Billing, Security) and attach the Access Matrix once filled by customer.
- Marcus: schedule the 30-min validation demo for Dec 15 and own the secure distribution of keys (we'll use the secure note flow).

I also attached a short runbook for the key seeding steps and the API key lifecycle notes. We'll capture the actual values in the secure notes doc rather than email.

Monica
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

--Attachment: api-key-seeding-runbook.md (markdown runbook, 3 steps)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Rodgers <sam.rodgers@cloverhealth.com>, Nadia Perez <nadia.perez@cloverhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access gatekeeper run-through & invite sequencing

Sam / Nadia —

Perfect, thanks for the quick answers. Confirming the plan and next steps: 

1) Please fill and return the attached access matrix (I attached the CSV again inline). Once we get that we will seed the keys on Dec 13.
2) We'll create two named projects in your tenant: clover-sbx-integration and clover-sbx-ingest. Monica will seed keys and set the ingest key rotation policy to 90 days.
3) We'll send invites to Nadia, Mike, and Priya on Dec 14. Invite emails will include a short first-login checklist and RBAC descriptions.
4) Live validation: Dec 15 at 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/tenant-validation/DEAL-D-2026-0842 (calendar invite to follow).

Security notes: we will not send raw keys over email. Keys will be published to a secure note and you will be granted a one-time access link. If you want service-principal-style rotation automation, Aditya can scope a short follow-up to configure managed tokens (optional).

I'll attach the filled schedule to the Drive folder after Monica seeds keys.

Cheers,
Marcus
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

--Related link: https://app.redwood.ai/s/DEAL-D-2026-0842/mutual-action-plan

One request: can the ingest key be tagged with our internal project code (CLV-PLAT-001) so our engineering tracker picks it up automatically? If yes, please tag it when seeding.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.
